title: ClarkAtlanta vs Howard: tuition, size, location
summary: Clark Atlanta University (ClarkAtlanta) versus Howard University (Howard). Also searched as Howard vs ClarkAtlanta. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University and Howard University are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by College Scorecard ownership code 2. Clark Atlanta University, located in Atlanta, has an undergraduate enrollment of 3,603 students, whereas Howard University in Washington enrolls 10,108 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Clark Atlanta is $28,310, which is lower compared to Howard University's in-state tuition of $35,810. These differences highlight variations in size, location, and cost between Clark Atlanta University and Howard University.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing Clark Atlanta University and Howard University in terms of cost, Clark Atlanta offers a tuition rate of $28,310 for both in-state and out-of-state students. In contrast, Howard University charges $35,810 for tuition regardless of residency status. This indicates that Clark Atlanta University has a lower tuition fee compared to Howard University. Additionally, the median debt for students who complete their programs at Clark Atlanta University is $27,000, which is slightly higher than the $24,500 median debt reported for Howard University graduates. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution.

In summary, Clark Atlanta University presents a more affordable tuition option relative to Howard University, though graduates from Clark Atlanta tend to carry a marginally higher median debt upon completion. These cost differences are important considerations for prospective students evaluating ClarkAtlanta vs Howard.

paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University and Howard University both offer traditional campus-based learning models in urban settings, with Clark Atlanta located in Atlanta, Georgia, and Howard situated in Washington, D.C. The campuses provide opportunities for in-person instruction and engagement within their respective cities. These distinctions in enrollment size and geographic location contribute to different campus experiences when considering ClarkAtlanta vs Howard.

sections.heading: Accreditation
paragraphs: Clark Atlanta University and Howard University are both accredited institutions, ensuring they meet established standards of quality in higher education.
